zh-CN.name: 政府采购网招标查询
zh-CN.summary: 输入企业名称（建议简称），返回采购公告列表与详情字段
zh-CN.description: 中国政府采购网招标公告查询——输入企业名称（或简称），搜索该企业参与的采购公告，返回公告列表（标题/链接/日期）并可深度提取详情字段（项目编号/采购人/代理机构/更正内容/联系人）。Use when 用户提到"查招投标"、"政府采购"、"采购公告"、"中标公告"、"招标信息"、"ccgp"、"企业中标"。

en-US.name: CCGP Procurement Search
en-US.summary: Search China Government Procurement announcements by company name
en-US.description: China Government Procurement (ccgp.gov.cn) announcement search — input a company name (short name recommended) and return procurement announcements (title / link / date), with optional deep extraction of detail fields (project number / purchaser / agency / corrections / contacts). Use when the user asks about tenders, procurement announcements, winning bids, or ccgp.
